title.zh: Meta未来支出承诺激增至8250亿美元
title.en: Meta未来支出承诺激增至8250亿美元

current_state.zh: Meta约8250亿美元未来支出承诺的披露已引发市场重新定价：股价大跌、信用风险指标创历史新高，并波及超大规模云计算与芯片行业的债务风险情绪。
current_state.en: The disclosure of Meta's roughly $825 billion in committed future spending has triggered a market repricing: shares sold off, credit risk indicators hit record highs, and debt-risk sentiment spread across hyperscale cloud and chip companies.

updates.title_zh: Meta未来支出承诺激增至8250亿美元
updates.title_en: Meta未来支出承诺激增至8250亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: 市场报告显示，Meta的前瞻性支出承诺已飙升至约8250亿美元，凸显超大规模厂商AI基础设施建设庞大的资本开支规模。
updates.what_changed_en: Market reports indicate Meta's forward spending commitments have surged to roughly $825 billion, underscoring the massive capex scale of hyperscaler AI infrastructure buildout.
updates.current_state_zh: 市场报告显示，Meta的前瞻性支出承诺已飙升至约8250亿美元，凸显超大规模厂商AI基础设施建设庞大的资本开支规模。
updates.current_state_en: Market reports indicate Meta's forward spending commitments have surged to roughly $825 billion, underscoring the massive capex scale of hyperscaler AI infrastructure buildout.

updates.title_zh: Meta从盘后大涨到股债双杀：未来支出承诺飙至8250亿美元，信用风险指标创历史新高
updates.title_en: Meta从盘后大涨到股债双杀：未来支出承诺飙至8250亿美元，信用风险指标创历史新高
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta披露约8250亿美元未来支出承诺后，股价从盘后上涨转为收跌约7%，五年期CDS升至历史最高，债券相对美债走弱，并引发超大规模云与芯片公司信用风险担忧蔓延。
updates.what_changed_en: After Meta disclosed about $825 billion in committed future spending, its stock reversed from a post-earnings rally to close down about 7%, its five-year CDS hit a record high, its bonds weakened versus Treasuries, and debt-risk concerns spread to hyperscale cloud and chip companies.
updates.current_state_zh: Meta约8250亿美元未来支出承诺的披露已引发市场重新定价：股价大跌、信用风险指标创历史新高，并波及超大规模云计算与芯片行业的债务风险情绪。
updates.current_state_en: The disclosure of Meta's roughly $825 billion in committed future spending has triggered a market repricing: shares sold off, credit risk indicators hit record highs, and debt-risk sentiment spread across hyperscale cloud and chip companies.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta's stock reversed from a post-earnings rally to a ~7% selloff after a regulatory filing revealed about $825 billion in committed future spending, largely for AI compute and data-center buildout, pushing its five-year credit default swap to a record high and spreading debt-risk concerns across hyperscale cloud and chip companies.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta's stock reversed from a post-earnings rally to a ~7% selloff after a regulatory filing revealed about $825 billion in committed future spending, largely for AI compute and data-center buildout, pushing its five-year credit default swap to a record high and spreading debt-risk concerns across hyperscale cloud and chip companies.
